Choose: A (recommended) build B1 for lines 1-3, keep the Pulsar p95 assertions soft, record before and after numbers in 09 section 7, and move the hard budget to a new perf item that profiles the GPU side of the Pulsar scene; B widen B1 to find and cut the GPU cost (open design, large, needs a re-plan); C keep line 4 and accept that it stays red.
